## Atopic eczema codelist — CPRD Read codes

Includes atopic dermatitis and recognised historical synonyms indicating a current diagnosis. Code–term variants are retained as returned by the CPRD tools.

| Read code | CPRD term |

| M11 | Atopic dermatitis |
| M111 | Atopic dermatitis/eczema |
| M111-97 | Dermatitis/eczemas NOS |

| M111-99 | Dermatitis/eczemas |
| M112 | Infantile eczema |
| M113 | Flexural eczema |
| M114 | Allergic (intrinsic) eczema |
| M115 | Besnier's prurigo |
| M116 | Neurodermatitis - diffuse |
| M116-1 | Brocq's neurodermatitis |
| M116-99 | Neurodermatitis |
| M117 | Atopic neurodermatitis |
| M11z | Atopic dermatitis NOS |
| M11z-99 | Atopic eczema/dermatitis NOS |

**Coding caveat:** `M111-97`, `M111-99` and `M116-99` have less-specific displayed terms but are variants of the relevant underlying Read codes. They are retained for code-based ascertainment; their wording alone is less specific for atopic eczema.

**Excluded:** history and family-history codes; atopy without eczema; referral alone; unspecified eczema, infected eczema or eczema exacerbation without an atopic diagnosis; and distinct conditions such as contact, seborrhoeic, discoid, asteatotic and varicose eczema. The entire `M11` hierarchy should **not** be included automatically, because it also contains non-atopic conditions.

A qualifying diagnosis indicates disease at the time of recording, not necessarily that it remains active indefinitely.

## Atopic eczema codelist — CPRD Read codes

The table below includes explicit atopic eczema diagnoses and recognised historical synonyms. Codes and descriptions are reproduced as returned by the CPRD searches.

| M11z-99 | Atopic eczema/dermatitis NOS |

**Coding caveat:** The generic descriptions attached to `M111` and `M116` are included because they are term variants of the corresponding atopic dermatitis/diffuse neurodermatitis codes. Localised neurodermatitis (`M1831`) is not included.

### Additional nonspecific eczema codes

These indicate current eczema but **do not establish that it is atopic**. Keep them separate from the strict codelist; include them only if your intended phenotype accepts nonspecific eczema diagnoses.

| Read code | CPRD term |
|---|---|
| M12z1 | Eczema |
| M12z1-99 | Chronic Eczema |
| M12z2 | Infected eczema |
| M12z3 | Hand eczema |
| M12z4 | Erythrodermic eczema |
| Myu22 | Exacerbation of eczema |

**Excluded:** family history, personal history and referral-only codes; contact, seborrhoeic, discoid, asteatotic, varicose and other distinct eczema types; and eczema herpeticum alone, which does not establish underlying atopic eczema.

A diagnostic entry indicates eczema at the time it was recorded; it does not by itself establish that the condition remains active at a later assessment date.

## Atopic eczema codelist — CPRD Read codes

The table below includes explicit atopic eczema diagnoses and recognised historical synonyms. Codes and descriptions are reproduced as returned by the CPRD searches.

| Read code | CPRD term |
|---|---|
| M11 | Atopic dermatitis |
| M111 | Atopic dermatitis/eczema |
| M111-97 | Dermatitis/eczemas NOS |
| M111-98 | Atopic eczema/dermatitis |
| M111-99 | Dermatitis/eczemas |
| M112 | Infantile eczema |
| M113 | Flexural eczema |
| M114 | Allergic (intrinsic) eczema |
| M115 | Besnier's prurigo |
| M116 | Neurodermatitis - diffuse |
| M116-1 | Brocq's neurodermatitis |
| M116-99 | Neurodermatitis |
| M117 | Atopic neurodermatitis |
| M11z | Atopic dermatitis NOS |
| M11z-99 | Atopic eczema/dermatitis NOS |

**Coding caveat:** The generic descriptions attached to `M111` and `M116` are included because they are term variants of the corresponding atopic dermatitis/diffuse neurodermatitis codes. Localised neurodermatitis (`M1831`) is not included.

### Additional nonspecific eczema codes

These indicate current eczema but **do not establish that it is atopic**. Keep them separate from the strict codelist; include them only if your intended phenotype accepts nonspecific eczema diagnoses.

| Read code | CPRD term |
|---|---|
| M12z1 | Eczema |
| M12z1-99 | Chronic Eczema |
| M12z2 | Infected eczema |
| M12z3 | Hand eczema |
| M12z4 | Erythrodermic eczema |
| Myu22 | Exacerbation of eczema |

**Excluded:** family history, personal history and referral-only codes; contact, seborrhoeic, discoid, asteatotic, varicose and other distinct eczema types; and eczema herpeticum alone, which does not establish underlying atopic eczema.

A diagnostic entry indicates eczema at the time it was recorded; it does not by itself establish that the condition remains active at a later assessment date.
